title: Kono Jishou Megami to Isekai Tenshou o!
subtitle: Kazuma Sato's day is going great. Then he dies and reawakens in an alternate reality.

title: Kono Chuunibyou ni Bakuen o!
subtitle: Kazuma joins the Adventurers Guild of his new, parallel world.

title: Kono Migite ni Pantsu o!
subtitle: Kazuma has formed a party of adventurers. Their first challenge: defeating an army of delicious flying cabbages.

title: Kono Kyouteki ni Bakuretsu Mahou o!
subtitle: The leader of the Devil King's army comes to town seeking revenge.

title: Kono Maken ni Onedan o!
subtitle: Aqua is locked in cage to protect her from attacks by Brutal Alligators. When the gators have gone, however, she refuses to leave the cage.

title: Kono Roku de mo Nai Tatakai ni Kecchaku o!
subtitle: Megumin loves annoying the leader of the Devil King's army. So he brings his army to town to kill her and everyone else.

title: Kono Kogoesou na Kisetsu ni Nidome no Shi o!
subtitle: Kazuma takes on a quest that looks easy, but it's a snow job.

title: Kono Fuyu o Kosenai Oretachi ni Ai no Te o!
subtitle: Kazuma and Aqua encounter another one of the eight leaders of the Devil King's army. It's the friendly, cute one.

title: Kono Subarashii Mise ni Shukufuku o!
subtitle: Kazuma signs a contract with a succubus. She promises that it only cost him a small part of his vitality.

title: Kono Rifujin na Yousai ni Shuuen o!
subtitle: The humongous robot "Mobile Fortress - Destroyer" is approaching the town. Its goal - humongous destruction.

title: Give Me Deliverance from This Judicial Injustice!
subtitle: Darkness, Aqua, and Megumin are back to continue their quest against the Devil King. Kazuma is back too, but the only adventures he has waiting for him exist within the criminal justice system.

title: A Friend for This Crimson Demon Girl!
subtitle: Megumin unhibernates the Giant Toads. They are hopping mad.

title: Peace for the Master of This Labyrinth!
subtitle: Aqua reveals a hidden part of herself.

title: A Betrothed for This Noble Daughter!
subtitle: An arranged marriage doesn't go as arranged.

title: Servitude for This Masked Knight!
subtitle: One of the adventurers joins with one of the Devil King's commanders.

title: Goodbye to This Irritating Living World!
subtitle: Kazuma starts a business relationship with a former Devil King commander.

title: An Invitation for This Knucklehead!
subtitle: Kazuma envisions a life of luxury after he sells an apple segmenter plus three almost-as-valuable items.

title: Sightseeing in This Pitiful City!
subtitle: The adventurers and a dragon are in a cart that has a draggin' outside.

title: A Goddess for This Corrupt Hot Springs Town!
subtitle: Only one of the adventurers thinks that the town packed with fanatical followers of Aqua is the swellest place ever.

title: God's Blessings on This Wonderful Party!
subtitle: Aqua's charm offensive causes her followers to want to kill her.

title: OVA: God's Blessings on This Wonderful Piece of Art!
subtitle: A Giant Robot uses Darkness as a toy.

title: God's Blessings on This Bright Future!
subtitle: After defeating Sylvia at the Crimson Demon Village, Kazuma and his party look forward to receiving a reward that could mean freedom from the grind of having to fulfill quests. Kazuma himself, however, seems to be having nightmares and bouts of paranoia.

title: A Smile for This Dour Girl!
subtitle: Kazuma and the gang receive a letter from Princess Iris. She wants to share a meal with them while hearing about their adventures. While Kazuma is giddy with wonderment of her beauty, Darkness is terrified of heads rolling in the event of any rudeness.

title: A Re-education for This Bright Little Girl!
subtitle: What started as dinner at Darkness's mansion with Princess Iris has turned into Kazuma being dragged back to the castle! Rain explains the situation, and Kazuma agrees to keep Iris company. His wild stories leave the princess with stars in her eyes.

title: Divine Punishment for This Handsome Gentleman Thief!
subtitle: Kazuma thinks of a way to stay in the capital for Iris's sake, and declares that he will capture the thief who's causing a stir in the streets! Since the thief targets nobles with bad behavior, Kazuma and his friends decide to stay at Alderp's mansion.

title: Nefarious Friends for This Sheltered Princess!
subtitle: Alarm sounds in the royal capital as the Devil King's army attacks. The adventurer's guild summons high-level adventurers to battle. After failing to capture a thief, Kazuma joins the fight to redeem his reputation.

title: A Farewell to This Lavish Lifestyle!
subtitle: Chris warns Kazuma the body-swap necklace is a dangerous sacred relic with life-threatening powers. Princess Iris's life is endangered when two robbers in black infiltrate the royal castle at night, likely after the necklace.

title: Rest for This Up-and-Coming Adventurer!
subtitle: Kazuma and his friends return to Axel and receive 300 million eris as a reward for subjugating Sylvia, an executive of the Devil King's army. Kazuma and Aqua go to high-end restaurants, and Aqua enjoys her long-awaited life as a celebrity.

title: An Eternal Rest for the Master of This Lake!
subtitle: Kazuma and his friends attempt to defeat Coulomb's Hydra but fail due to low-level adventurers, a bandit spree, and a bounty. However, for some reason, Darkness insists on defeating the Hydra.

title: A Talking-To for This Runaway!
subtitle: Darkness departs the mansion leaving behind a note. Not satisfied by a single note, Kazuma, Aqua, and Megumin protest in front of the Dustiness manor but are rudely turned away. Kazuma, frustrated with everything, is approached by Dust who needs his help.

title: Blessings for This Selfish Bride!
subtitle: Darkness's wedding to Aldarp is imminent. Despite Aqua's and Megumin's pleas, Kazuma has no intention of intervening. Vanir then visits the mansion and reveals a shocking secret to Kazuma.

title: God's Blessings for These Unchanging Days!
subtitle: Kazuma has crashed Darkness's wedding to Aldarp and pays him the two billion eris he says he's owed. Aqua and Kazuma try to make off with Darkness but Aldarp won't relinquish her so easily and orders his guards to stop their escape.
